limits: This trusts the accepted verifier report and retained file hashes as the verification basis; it is not a replacement raw-quote source replay.
Declared 0.1 bps slippage is a frozen research assumption. Financing, commissions and market impact remain unmodeled.
Owner test execution and separate actual episode result are not attributed to this reviewer.
review_scope: Read-only helper and focused test-source review; no independent tests, actual episode evaluation, runtime change or broker action.
verified_boundaries: Exact selected GBP_USD bid/ask midpoint and half-spreads, integer original base units, and side-correct 0.1 bps per-leg hypothetical slippage.

Each closed original virtual trade reconciles signed gross midpoint movement minus both retained half-spreads and slippage to its retained realized quote-currency/USD P&L. Decimal96 arithmetic is isolated from ambient precision.
Original entry, quote IDs and market/availability/action clocks are retained and checked; five counterfactual arms have separate positions and cash chains.
Only actual recorded virtual_action legs count. Hypothetical liquidation marks do not create trades or costs; open-entry costs are separately disclosed outside realized totals.
Full accepted verifier-report file digest, exact registered source closure, original settlement-file hashes and state/step arithmetic are checked before attributing retained trades.
Incomplete episode disposition and original fixed terminal eligibility remain explicit; no independent trial count, actual account aggregation or broker-fill claim.
